definitions.explanation: A general term encompassing both pottery (earthenware/stoneware) and porcelain. Refers to objects made from clay that are shaped and fired in a kiln.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{陶磁器|とうじき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界的|せかいてき}→世界的：20935_sekaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{陶磁器|とうじき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw an exhibition of old ceramics at the art museum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有田焼|ありたやき}→有田焼：28604_aritayaki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{陶磁器|とうじき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Arita ware is one of the most representative ceramics of Japan.

notes:
USAGE:
A comprehensive term covering both ⟦{陶器|とうき}→陶器：14531_touki⟧ (pottery, earthenware) and ⟦{磁器|じき}→磁器：03335_jiki⟧ (porcelain). Japan has a long tradition of ceramic arts, with famous regional styles such as ⟦{有田焼|ありたやき}→有田焼：28604_aritayaki⟧, {瀬戸焼|せとやき}, and {益子焼|ましこやき}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {陶磁器|とうじき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧ (ceramics production area)
- {陶磁器|とうじき}⟦{市|いち}→市：10013_ichi⟧ (ceramics market/fair)
- {陶磁器|とうじき}⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧ (ceramics museum)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{陶器|とうき}→陶器：14531_touki⟧: pottery, earthenware (lower firing temperature)
- ⟦{磁器|じき}→磁器：03335_jiki⟧: porcelain (higher firing temperature, translucent)
- ⟦{焼|や}き{物|もの}→焼き物：04974_yakimono⟧: pottery, ceramics (more casual term)
